Definition: from G4862 and G345; to recline in company with (at a meal):--sit (down, at the table, together) with (at meat).
BiblicalUsage: As Jesus sits at meat in Matthew's house, many publicans and sinners come and sit down with Him and His disciples, and at the great supper one of those who sits at meat with Him says, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God. Sitting at table with Jesus is the picture of the kingdom: sinners welcomed, and the blessedness of eating bread with Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the table of Jesus is open to sinners, and I hold that eating with Him now is a foretaste of the bread of the kingdom.
